name: Front Mission Online

env.name: FMO_DB
env.description: 1 keeps the pilots in PostgreSQL, 0 in the JSON character store.

env.name: FMO_UDP_PEER_LINK
env.description: The peer link between pilots (release default on).

env.name: FMO_CHAR_WIRE_BASE
env.description: Character id base the client sees (release default 0x1000).

env.name: FMO_BATTLE_DEATH_END
env.description: Seconds after a pilot's wanzer is destroyed until their battle ends (release default 5).

env.name: FMO_GROUP_VOICE_TO
env.description: Group voice routing: talkers (release default) or all.

env.name: FMO_DEVTOOL_PORT
env.description: Port of the lobby NPC editor (8798 to use the published port). Empty: off.

env.name: FMO_DEVTOOL_BIND
env.description: Address the NPC editor binds. Empty: loopback.

env.name: FMO_DEVTOOL_TOKEN
env.description: Token the NPC editor requires on a wider bind.

env.name: POL_BOARDS_FMO_URL
env.description: City Control board: the public URL Discord messages link to.

env.name: POL_BOARDS_FMO_DISCORD_WEBHOOK
env.description: City Control board: webhook for the standings.

env.name: POL_BOARDS_FMO_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: City Control board: an optional Discord bot's token (a secret).

env.name: POL_BOARDS_FMO_DISCORD_APP_ID
env.description: City Control board: the bot's application id.

env.name: POL_BOARDS_FMO_DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY
env.description: City Control board: the bot's public key.

env.name: HIPPAULFRONT_TAG
env.description: Version of the published game image (docker-compose.ghcr.yml).

data.description: The cipher tables, computed from public constants. The published image carries them.
The rank ladder, the class curve and the catalogues (and the board's backdrop). The server runs without them, with gaps.

import.label: game data
import.hint: your FRONT MISSION ONLINE install folder, the one holding PolBoot.exe and Data/

notes: The title plugin (fmotitle) only fills the Viewer's profile screen. The admin panel's NPC and story-gate tools are the fmo service's devtool port (FMO_DEVTOOL_PORT), reached through POL_ADMIN_GAME_FMO_URL and _TOKEN (services/admingames.py).
